# OpenWorkSpace

> Local-first open-source workspace foundation for discovering, describing, verifying, and extending software capabilities and AI tools.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/HuffmanMainNode/OpenWorkSpace
License: Apache-2.0 for original project code
Stage: pre-alpha foundation
Runtime: Python 3.11+
Offline-first: yes, for implemented local workflows
Hosted service required: no
Third-party code execution: disabled
OS sandbox: not implemented

## Start here
- README.md: project overview, installation, commands, current capabilities, and limitations.
- openworkspace.json: machine-readable project discovery descriptor.
- AGENTS.md: operating and safety instructions for AI agents and automation.
- SECURITY.md: security policy and trust boundaries.
- CONTRIBUTING.md: human contribution workflow.
- GOVERNANCE.md: project governance and review.
- REPOSITORY-CATALOG.md: implementation inventory.
- STRATEGIC-REVIEW-AND-ADOPTION-PLAN.md: architecture assessment and roadmap.

## Contracts and data
- specifications/README.md: versioned JSON Schema contracts.
- specifications/: normative JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 files.
- data/README.md: shared reference catalogs.
- data/catalogs/: permission, lifecycle, trust, resource, and domain vocabularies.
- examples/README.md: synthetic, non-executable examples.
- examples/contracts/: schema fixtures.

## Architecture and qualification
- architecture/master-architecture.md
- architecture/threat-model.md
- architecture/trust-model.md
- architecture/security-requirements.md
- architecture/integration-model.md
- architecture/compatibility-policy.md
- qualification/requirements.yaml
- qualification/test-matrix.yaml

## Resource ecosystem
- catalog/README.md: first-party and community resource catalog policy.
- catalog/first-party/README.md: first-party repository collection.
- catalog/community/README.md: third-party resource policy.
- catalog/packs/README.md: optional curated pack policy.
- contributions/README.md: contributor intake process.
- local-resources/README.md: local-only user resource workspace; not auto-loaded.
- contributions/inbox/README.md: where pull-request proposals are submitted.
- contributions/templates/contribution.json: contribution manifest template.
- specifications/contribution.schema.json: contribution manifest schema.

## Safety and limitations
A valid manifest is not a trust decision, permission grant, security review, or execution approval. Current permission evaluation is advisory, not OS enforcement. Tasks are lifecycle records, not workers. Messaging is local-only. Resource and package intake is metadata and digest verification, not download, installation, or execution. No arbitrary third-party code is executed.
